overview.text: The Western Ground Snake is a small, harmless snake of the south-western United States and northern Mexico that comes in many colours and patterns.

identification.text: Brown, red or orange, with black bands, stripes, or no pattern at all; white or grey belly; smooth scales.

size.label: Adults
size.text: About 8 to 19 in (20 to 48 cm) long.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: The south-western and south-central USA and northern Mexico.

habitat.text: Dry, rocky places with loose soil.

behaviour.text: Secretive and active at night, often found on roadsides foraging.

diet.text: Invertebrates: spiders, scorpions, centipedes, crickets and insect larvae.

recognise.text: Small snake with very variable bands or stripes.
